name: jung-dream-analysis
description: Guided dream interpretation using C.G. Jung's method: dramatic dream structure, personal association, archetypal amplification, compensation, and individuation — via a /dream command, an auto-triggering skill, and reference material on archetypes and common dream motifs.

description_i18n.en: Guided dream interpretation using C.G. Jung's method: dramatic dream structure, personal association, archetypal amplification, compensation, and individuation — via a /dream command, an auto-triggering skill, and reference material on archetypes and common dream motifs.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 C.G. 荣格的方法进行引导式释梦：梦的戏剧结构、个人联想、原型放大、补偿与自性化分析。提供 /dream 命令、可自动触发的技能，以及关于原型与常见梦境意象的参考资料。
